lines.en: I swim low along the shallows.
My tail never stops, flicking the weeds.
A little sand lifts from the bottom.
I follow the cracks in the riverbed.

lines.zh: 河岸的泥是软的，我踩得陷。
lines.en: The bank mud is soft and I sink.

lines.zh: 我从一丛水草里穿过去。
lines.en: I slip through a clump of weeds.

lines.zh: 呼吸的时候，水面冒小泡。
lines.en: Small bubbles rise when I breathe.

lines.zh: 我游过河床上一块阴影。
lines.en: I pass a shadow on the riverbed.

lines.zh: 有东西从上面经过，我下沉。
lines.en: Something passes overhead. I sink.
I nudge along in the shallows.

lines.zh: 河底的碎石硌着我的肚子。
lines.en: Pebbles graze my belly.

lines.zh: 我绕过一根倒下的木头。
lines.en: I go around a sunken log.

lines.zh: 我往水草更密的地方去。
lines.en: I head for thicker weeds.
Swimming, I tilt a little.
I cling to the big stone by the bank.
I hover on the bottom, tail barely moving.
I look up at the surface.
A frog jumps in from the bank.
I open my mouth and eat nothing.
The riverbed is very quiet.
I burrow a little into the sand.
I am small enough to hide.
The current brings a scent.
I turn my head downstream.
The light on the surface wavers.
One flick of the tail, then still.

lines.zh: 我听着水草被推的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the weeds being pushed.
The mud below is cool.

lines.zh: 水里的东西比岸上的多。
lines.en: There is more in the water than on shore.
Do not jump in.
I am too small to be a meal.
Your shadow covers the water.
I slid behind the weeds.
Your fingers do not reach down here.
I can see your feet.
Have you come to catch me?

lines.zh: 别搅水，我什么都看不清。
lines.en: Do not stir the water. I cannot see.
The water tips me over.
One spot aches.
I squeeze into a crack.
A little red drifts in the water.
My tail beats fast.
I head for deeper water.
Do not hurt me again.

lines.zh: 水花一翻，我的鳞片被撞掉。
lines.en: The water churns and scales scrape off me.
Is this a worm?
I sniff it. Not quite right.
Leave it on the bottom. I will come.
I circle half around before approaching.
One small mouthful is enough.
I do not touch things on the surface.
Step back a little.

lines.zh: 水里那点碎肉，是给我的吗？
lines.en: Is that scrap of meat in the water for me?
You stepped on the riverbed.
I am small. One nudge overturns me.
Each to their own channel.
I am used to that much.
Your boots have stirred the mud.
I brace against the stone.
The splash blinds me.
Do not stamp your feet in the water.
I am barely half a block long.
There are few of my kind here.
Let us see how the current runs first.
We do not speak of that in the water.
I must avoid predators first.
You ask too directly.

lines.zh: 我连自己的洞都没挖好。
lines.en: I have not even dug my burrow.
We can speak later.
Do not muddy the water.
I should swim back.
A small thing on the bottom.
I tried a bite.
Too hard. I spit it out.
I push it with my mouth.
This much is edible.

lines.zh: 我把它埋进钦利组的沙里。
lines.en: I bury it in Chinle sand.
The current washes it away.

lines.zh: 地上（水底）的东西，我收着。
lines.en: I keep what lies on the bottom.
This stone is not food.
Something moves above.
I shrink into the weeds.
I see it, at the surface.
I should not be in these shallows.
I tuck my tail in.
Those are feet, not fish.
I press to the bottom, still.
The water sways, and I sway.
I count the sounds in the water.
Any closer and I burrow.
I keep my head raised.
Good. Hold still.
I hide behind the stone.
Only one eye shows.

lines.zh: 水流把我的味道带走了。
lines.en: The current carries my scent away.
Your shadow is still on the surface.
I sink by degrees.
The bottom mud can hide me.
I wait for the current to quicken.
The weeds hide me nicely.
Do not come into the water.
Just like that. Do not move.
I sank back a little.
Sink a while longer.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的河水很浅，我贴着底走。
lines.en: Triassic water is shallow; I keep to the bottom.
I bump your ankle.
I slap the water with my tail.
I bite your bootlace.
This force is very small.
Water splashes your face.
I dart in and back out.
My teeth are fine and small.
This cannot even break skin.
I retreat into the weeds.
I only want you to leave.
Do not follow me down.
I was born in the shallows.
A ring of ripples on the surface.
The sand on the bottom is new.
I swim out of the weeds.
This river is not large.
First I slip into a crack.
The water is cool. Just right.
My tail moves first.
A small sound on the bank.
I swim slowly along the bottom.
I glance up.
This place will hide me.
I circled the riverbed once.
The bottom is safer than the bank.
The water has grown hot.

lines.zh: 我从水里被抛起来，又落回去。
lines.en: I am thrown up and fall back in.

lines.zh: 我本来就在水里，可这水深得难受。
lines.en: I live in water, yet this depth hurts.

lines.zh: 爆炸把河底搅成一团泥。
lines.en: The blast churns the riverbed to mud.

lines.zh: 一支箭射进水里，擦过我。
lines.en: An arrow entered the water and grazed me.
This light will not disperse in water.
Nothing to eat on the bottom.

lines.zh: 电顺着水走，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Current runs through the water and numbs me.
